archive.title: From the archive
archive.text: Written in {year}, when the platform ran on its previous core. In 2026 the platform was rebuilt from the ground up: the text is kept as it was, the product has moved on.
post.author: By {author}
contact.title: Write to the team
contact.lead: A person from the team answers by e-mail, usually the same working day. Bought a ticket? Write to the organizer of your event: their contact is in the ticket e-mail.
contact.name: Your name
contact.privacy: We keep your message to answer it. Questions and answers, without your name and e-mail, help us improve the answers on this site. [Privacy policy](/legal/privacy)
contact.sent: Thank you. Your message reached the team; the answer comes to {email}.
contact.error.invalid: Fill in your name, a valid e-mail and the question (at least 10 characters).
contact.error.turnstile: The anti-spam check did not pass. Wait a second for it to finish and try again.
contact.error.rate: Too many messages. Try again in a few minutes.
contact.error.unavailable: The form is not available right now. Write to us in the Telegram chat or at {email}.
contact.error.network: No connection to the server. Check your internet and try again.
